تستأنفوا (form X)
# تَسْتَأْنِفُوا (tastaʔnifū) /tas.taʔ.ni.fuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَأْنَفَ (istaʔnafa)
# تُسْتَأْنَفُوا (tustaʔnafū) /tus.taʔ.na.fuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَأْنَفَ (istaʔnafa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
